title: Showdown
novel:
The wedding was only days away, and Lily was [[stress|stress]]-eating everything in sight. But the real [[drama|drama]] was not about the flowers or the cake. It was about Barney and Lily's [[grandmother|grandmother]].

Barney had always been the center of [[attention|attention]] in the group, but lately, Lily's grandmother — a tiny woman named [[Gammy|Gammy]] who looked like a [[porcelain|porcelain]] [[doll|doll]] — was [[stealing|steal]] his [[spotlight|spotlight]]. She told better stories, she had [[dirtier|dirty]] jokes, and she even beat him at his own game of [[laser tag|laser tag]].

"This cannot [[stand|stand]]," Barney [[declared|declare]]. "I challenge Gammy to a [[showdown|showdown]]."

The showdown took place at MacLaren's. The [[categories|category]] were: best [[pick-up line|pick-up line]], best [[dance|dance]] move, and best [[storytelling|storytell]]. Barney [[expected|expect]] to [[dominate|dominate]].

Gammy's first pick-up line: "I might be [[eighty|eighty]], but my [[pacemaker|pacemaker]] still beats faster when I see you." The bar [[exploded|explode]] with [[laughter|laugh]]. Barney's line about a [[lobster|lobster]] — nobody even [[pretended|pretend]] to laugh.

For [[dance|dance]], Gammy did the [[robot|robot]] — at eighty-two years old — and [[nailed|nail]] it. Barney tried to [[breakdance|breakdance]] and [[pulled|pull]] a [[muscle|muscle]].

For [[storytelling|storytell]], Gammy told the story of how she met her late husband in [[Paris|Paris]] during the war. By the end, everyone was in tears — including Barney.

"You win," he said, [[kneeling|kneel]] before her. "Teach me your ways."

Gammy [[patted|pat]] his head. "The first lesson: you do not need to be the center of attention to be [[loved|love]]."

Barney was quiet for a moment. "That's actually... really good [[advice|advice]]."

stress.en: to feel worried and unable to relax

drama.en: an exciting or emotional situation involving a lot of conflict

attention.en: the act of looking at or thinking about someone or something

porcelain.en: a hard white material used to make cups, plates, and decorative objects

doll.en: a toy that looks like a small person

spotlight.en: a light that shines brightly on one area; the center of attention

dirty.en: not clean; referring to sex in a rude or humorous way

laser tag.en: a game where players shoot at each other with laser guns

stand.en: to be able to accept or deal with a bad situation

showdown.en: a final battle or contest to decide who wins

category.en: a group of things that share similar qualities

pick-up line.en: a funny or clever sentence used to start a romantic conversation

dance.en: a set of movements to music

dominate.en: to have control over someone or be better than everyone else

pacemaker.en: a device put inside the body to keep the heart beating regularly

explode.en: to burst loudly; (of a crowd) to suddenly make a lot of noise

lobster.en: a large sea animal with a hard shell and claws eaten as food

pretend.en: to behave as if something is true when it is not

robot.en: a machine that can do tasks automatically; a dance style

nail.en: (slang) to do something perfectly or successfully

breakdance.en: to dance in a style that includes spinning on the ground

muscle.en: a piece of flesh that moves parts of your body

pat.en: to touch someone gently with your hand

advice.en: suggestions about what you think someone should do
